revisionBoundaries: Final game includes immediate mass/inertia recomputation before wheel-controller creation, current-proxy takeover disposal and physical damage for a stationary struck chassis.

Final full units and browser regressions are rerun after the direct finish-billboard texture-node and async lab-pause corrections; the 99-unit/6-fleet pass and 3-failed/1-passed retained-vehicle pre-route-fix attempt stay separate.

Population timed/reaction reports precede only the final billboard/lab-pause edits, at c2397cc537a4473bda7a7649d45e3725b8e52ec799c5ee24d5cf8eed54a55304. NPC/vehicle/physics modules are byte-identical; these are explicitly not fresh final-revision FPS or fairness acceptance.
Timed observation is actual wall time; its limited simulation advance under severe software FPS is explicitly recorded. Accelerated loaded/pure soaks are separate.
The handoff fingerprint captures final sources; it is not an independently captured commit for every run.
No fresh exhaustive full-map/risky-branch/hardware/listening/long-memory-soak acceptance is claimed.
limitations: Near60 FPS with ten near cars, busy Medium and Radeon840M 1080p60 not accepted; reported lag is not considered solved.
Long queues up to the recorded raw waits span signal cycles; strict no-stuck/fairness acceptance is open even when sampled overlap/red/crossing/finite checks are clean.
SAT is sampled and slightly inset; not exhaustive swept collision auditing across every graph/seed.
Human handling/listening, physical controller/wheel/rumble and pedestrian seating/social alignment remain unaccepted.
Two motorcycles are original CC0 fallbacks; six recordings are processed into twelve designs, not twelve calibrated dyno sets.
Low-poly art, far-city/terrain/road blending, long GPU-memory soak and historical <=8ms streaming/full-map flight gates remain open.
No complete touch-only on-foot controller, native wheel force feedback, police, weapons or deep radio.
